title: The WalkUp | Cocktail bar in downtown Cary, NC

copy.text: Cary’s new, stylish, light-filled bar with exposed-brick walls serving classic cocktails, craft beers and great times.
Our Beverage Menu changes often, so check it out and find your favorites. Fall / Winter 2026.
Light-filled, with exposed-brick walls, timber beams and plant-filled lounge spaces. Up one flight of stairs.
We invite you to walk up and check us out. Sign up below to stay in the know.
Upstairs, above Happy’s. Laid-back cocktail bar featuring cozy, plant-filled lounge spaces and outdoor seating.
